title: RAID BACKPACK CLOSE BUTTON
why: His Q1 rule: every menu screen gets a close button and ESC closes it. The raid backpack had ESC, Tab and B but no button. One 36 px ghost square with the close glyph (the pad B when the last input was a pad) sits in the top right of the card header; a click does what ESC does.
now: The raid backpack has a close button in its corner.

edits.replacement:
var cy=y+LH(36)*BZ;   // v28.xx (cw-bagclose): the header is 6 px taller so the close button sits inside it
  ctx.font=bFS(TYPE.title);
